title: GST Registration
description: Bidder must possess an active Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (GSTIN) registered in India.

title: Permanent Account Number (PAN)
description: Bidder must possess a valid PAN issued by the Income Tax Department matching entity legal name.

title: Udyam MSME Registration
description: Valid Udyam Registration Certificate for claiming MSME purchase preference or exemption.

title: Minimum Annual Turnover
description: Average audited annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last 3 financial years must be at least INR 5,00,00,000.

title: Past Experience in IT Infrastructure
description: Bidder must have successfully executed similar server and networking supply contracts for at least 3 years.

title: OEM Manufacturer Authorization
description: Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) directly issued by the OEM for server hardware warranty and service commitment.

title: Class-I Local Content Requirement
description: Declaration indicating domestic value addition / local content of at least 50% as per Make in India (MII) order.

title: Technical Specification Compliance
description: Compliance sheet confirming 100% adherence to technical specifications for compute nodes, memory, and networking.

title: Delivery Timeline Commitment
description: Delivery, installation, and commissioning of entire infrastructure must be completed within 60 calendar days.
